$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for fda/ndc, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` on code, code_display and parent_code, the shapes descriptor.overrides.json publishes (digits only at 5, 9 or 11 digits; the FDA's hyphenated layouts); the closed `enum` domains on level, text_source and dea_schedule; the release pattern; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes elsewhere. NOT ENFORCED, by design: product_type and marketing_category, which the FDA can extend between refreshes and which would stop a fortnightly refresh for a new value that is not wrong; numeric ranges and dates (a numeric `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR); NULLs (invisible to ft_validate); object-level `required` (documentation only); and the list columns, which do not melt to a string shape. Free-text fields carry LOOSE length envelopes with headroom. Derived from build/stage/ndc.parquet on openFDA's 2026-10-30 file: a pass-through on today's rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (a malformed or mis-padded code, an unknown DEA schedule).
title: fda/ndc
